record.field:
SENCROP · Odoo Integration

Official API base URL: https://api.sencrop.com/v1

1) Connection

Type: REST

Authentication handled via API token configured in the Remote Control record.

connection_params example:

{
  "Authorization": "Bearer <API_TOKEN>"
}

2) Device & Sensor Configuration

Uses standard Odoo models:

  • Device: mdm.measurement.device
  • Sensor: mdm.measurement.device.sensor

Each sensor must define in remotecontrol_params a JSON with:

{
  "device_id": "124295",
  "measure": "SOIL_MOISTURE_20CM"
}

Parameters:

  • device_id: Sencrop device numeric ID
  • measure: One of the measures supported by the device

3) Workflow

  1. Get Devices Plan
    Builds bag["sensors_plan"] with one entry per sensor, containing:
    • sensor_id (Odoo sensor)
    • device_id (Odoo device)
    • device_code (Sencrop device id)
    • measure
  2. Get Readings Data
    For each plan entry, calls: 
    /devices/{device_id}/measures/{measure}
    and processes returned observations.

4) Device Matching Logic

Devices are matched using the Sencrop device ID, not the name.

  • The ID is taken from remotecontrol_params.device_id
  • This avoids issues with Unicode names or renamed devices

5) API Response Format

Typical Sencrop response:

{
  "values": [
    {
      "date": "2025-12-17T10:00:00Z",
      "value": 23.6
    }
  ]
}

6) Data Conversion

  • value: converted to float
  • date: converted from ISO format to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

7) Database Upsert Logic

Each observation is upserted into:

mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading

Unique key:

{
  "sensor_id": SENSOR_ID,
  "measurement_time": TIMESTAMP
}

Stored values:

  • value
  • remotecontrol_origin_id

8) Date Window for Fetching Data

The fetch window is computed per sensor:

  1. Last imported reading date + 1 day
  2. Otherwise: 01/01/{current_year}

To date:

{today}T23:59:59

9) Error Handling

  • Missing device_id or measure → sensor skipped
  • No values returned → no data for that period
  • Invalid numeric value → reading skipped and logged
  • HTTP / API error → logged and counted

10) Execution Sequence

  1. Get Devices Plan (sequence 10)
  2. Get Readings Data (sequence 20)
  3. Calculate Computed Sensors: a separate procedure recomputes every sensor with Transformation Type "Multiple Sensors" whose device is linked to this Remote Control, using the latest active measurement value of each configured dependency sensor.

11) Audit & Logging

After execution, a JSON audit file is attached to the Remote Control record containing:

  • Execution timestamp
  • Total readings processed
  • Total upserts
  • Total errors
  • Per-sensor details (URL, points, errors)

Attachment name format:

sencrop_readings_fetch_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json

A message is also posted on the Remote Control:

[Sencrop Readings] upserts=X errors=Y

import logging import sys from datetime import datetime from datetime import timedelta
_logger = logging.getLogger('remotecontrol_sencrop') BATCH_SIZE = 1000
is_test_execution = False _frame = sys._getframe() while _frame: if _frame.f_code.co_name in ('test_run', 'test_execute'): is_test_execution = True break _frame = _frame.f_back
Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 total_sensors = len(plan)
partner_id = bag.get('partner_id') token = bag.get('token') if not token or not partner_id: raise Exception("Token or partner_id missing in bag")
base_url = 'https://api.sencrop.com/v1'
now_utc = datetime.utcnow() before_date = now_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
_logger.info( '[Sencrop] Get readings start: remote_id=%s sensors=%s batch_size=%s test_mode=%s', Remote.id, total_sensors, BATCH_SIZE, is_test_execution, )
for sensor_idx, sensor_plan in enumerate(plan, 1): sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] device_code = sensor_plan['device_code'] measure = sensor_plan['measure']
sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id)
url = "%s/users/%s/devices/%s/data/raw?size=1000&beforeDate=%s&measures=%s" % ( base_url, partner_id, device_code, before_date, measure, )
headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % token, 'Accept': 'application/json', }
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=60) code = resp.status_code if code >= 400: total_errors += 1 _logger.warning( '[Sencrop] Sensor %s/%s (sensor_id=%s device_id=%s) HTTP %s error: %s', sensor_idx, total_sensors, sensor_id, device_id, code, (resp.text or '')[:200], ) continue
payload = resp.json() or [] if not isinstance(payload, list): total_errors += 1 _logger.warning( '[Sencrop] Sensor %s/%s (sensor_id=%s device_id=%s) response is not a list', sensor_idx, total_sensors, sensor_id, device_id, ) continue
total_readings = len(payload) _logger.info( '[Sencrop] Sensor %s/%s (sensor_id=%s device_id=%s): 0/%s readings to process', sensor_idx, total_sensors, sensor_id, device_id, total_readings, )
upserts = 0 errs = 0
for reading_idx, obs in enumerate(payload, 1): raw_value = obs.get('value') raw_ts = obs.get('date')
try: dt_obj = datetime.strptime(raw_ts, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z") measurement_time = dt_obj.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") except Exception: measurement_time = None
try: valf = float(str(raw_value).replace(',', '.')) except Exception: valf = None
if measurement_time and valf is not None: try: with env.cr.savepoint(): Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', { 'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': measurement_time, }, { 'value': valf, 'remotecontrol_origin_id': Remote.id, }, ) upserts += 1 except Exception as e: env.clear() errs += 1 try: err_msg = str(e).decode('utf-8', 'replace') except Exception: err_msg = unicode(e) _logger.error( u'[Sencrop] Failed reading on sensor_id=%s device_id=%s ts=%s value=%s: %s', sensor_id, device_id, measurement_time, valf, err_msg, ) else: errs += 1 _logger.warning( u'[Sencrop] Invalid reading on sensor_id=%s device_id=%s ts=%s value=%s', sensor_id, device_id, raw_ts, raw_value, )
if (reading_idx % BATCH_SIZE == 0) or (reading_idx == total_readings): if not is_test_execution: try: env.cr.commit() except Exception as commit_err: _logger.warning('[Sencrop] Batch commit warning: %s', commit_err) _logger.info( '[Sencrop] Sensor %s/%s (sensor_id=%s): %s/%s readings processed (batch committed=%s, upserts=%s, errors=%s)', sensor_idx, total_sensors, sensor_id, reading_idx, total_readings, not is_test_execution, upserts, errs, )
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs
except Exception as e: env.clear() total_errors += 1 try: err_msg = str(e).decode('utf-8', 'replace') except Exception: err_msg = unicode(e) _logger.error( u'[Sencrop] Sensor %s/%s (sensor_id=%s) request exception: %s', sensor_idx, total_sensors, sensor_id, err_msg, )
Remote.message_post(body=u"[Sencrop Readings] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors)) _logger.info( '[Sencrop] Get readings finished: remote_id=%s total_upserts=%s total_errors=%s test_mode=%s', Remote.id, total_upserts, total_errors, is_test_execution, )
bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors

Remote = self.remote_id result = Remote.compute_device_multi_sensor_readings() bag['computed_sensors_computed'] = result.get('computed') bag['computed_sensors_errors'] = result.get('errors') bag['computed_sensors_error_details'] = result.get('error_details') body = u"[Computed Sensors] computed=%s errors=%s" % ( result.get('computed'), result.get('errors')) error_details = result.get('error_details') or [] if error_details: body += u"
    " for error_detail in error_details: body += u"
  • %s: %s
    • " % ( error_detail.get('sensor_name'), error_detail.get('message')) body += u"
" Remote.message_post(body=body)
